primary_buyer_question: What should a B2B SaaS team do when security questionnaires, AI-use questions or trust evidence requests are slowing a deal?
safe_answer: Start with a no-credentials owner-evidence review before buying another tool or reusing old answers. Separate which questions have approved evidence, which need legal/security/privacy review, which have no verified source, and which claims must stop until an accountable owner approves them.
decision_lanes: tooling or workflow can help after evidence ownership is clear
claim_boundaries: No credentials, secrets, customer identifiers, production exports or confidential security files are needed for the first diagnostic fit check.
No legal, privacy, compliance, security, procurement, revenue, win-rate, faster-sales-cycle or ROI claim is made.
This is not a customer case study, testimonial, benchmark, certification, ranking proof or platform partnership claim.
Security, privacy, legal, compliance and procurement decisions require qualified owner review.
